explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, R + CAN + SAWS gives the state's pronunciation, 'AR-kan-saw'.

clue.text: Part of former colony controlled by Victoria's legislators

definitions.text: Part of former colony controlled by Victoria's legislators

parts.note: Victoria suggests the old queen or the Australian state, but it is the Canadian provincial capital where the provincial parliament sits

explanation.walkthrough: Victoria tempts toward the queen or the Australian state; it is in fact the capital of a Canadian province, once a British colony.
explanation.definitionFit: A western Canadian province, once a British colony, whose legislature sits in its capital city Victoria.
